tooltip: LED : Allows you to control the LED state of the camera
content1: Allows you to turn the camera LED on or off.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current LED state of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the LED state of the camera. Pass 1 to turn ON, 0 to turn OFF.

tooltip: Scene Mode : Allows you to set the scene mode of the camera
content1: Allows you to set the scene mode of the camera to optimize image quality for different environments such as intraoral capture or face imaging.
content2:
DensiCAMSceneMode Enum indicates the specific scene mode to be applied:
  1. Intraoral (0x01) : Optimized for intraoral dental imaging.
  2. Face (0x02) : Optimized for face capture.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current scene mode of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the scene mode of the camera.

tooltip: Orientation : Allows you to set the flip/orientation of the camera image
content1: Allows you to flip the camera image horizontally, vertically, both, or neither.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current orientation/flip mode of the camera. Returns 0 = None, 1 = Horizontal, 2 = Vertical, 3 = Both.
setAPIDes: This function sets the orientation of the camera image. 0 = None, 1 = Horizontal flip, 2 = Vertical flip, 3 = Both.

tooltip: Denoise : Allows you to set the denoise strength of the camera
content1: Allows you to control the noise reduction strength applied to the camera image. A higher value applies stronger noise reduction.
content2: Denoise value ranges from 0 (no noise reduction) to 15 (maximum noise reduction).
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current denoise strength value of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the denoise strength of the camera. Valid range: 0:15.

tooltip: Pixel Target Value : Allows you to set the pixel target value for auto exposure
content1: Allows you to set the target pixel brightness value used by the camera's auto exposure algorithm. A higher value results in a brighter target image.
content2: Pixel target value ranges from 0 to 512.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current pixel target value of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the pixel target value of the camera. Valid range: 0:512.

tooltip: Brightness : Allows you to set the brightness of the camera
content1: Allows you to control the brightness level of the camera image.
content2:
DensiCAMControlRange struct holds the brightness range and current value:
  - min: Minimum brightness value.
  - max: Maximum brightness value.
  - def: Default brightness value.
  - cur: Current brightness value.
  - res: Resolution step.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the brightness range and current value of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the brightness of the camera.

tooltip: Contrast : Allows you to set the contrast of the camera
content1: Allows you to control the contrast level of the camera image.
content2:
DensiCAMControlRange struct holds the contrast range and current value:
  - min: Minimum contrast value.
  - max: Maximum contrast value.
  - def: Default contrast value.
  - cur: Current contrast value.
  - res: Resolution step.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the contrast range and current value of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the contrast of the camera.

tooltip: Saturation : Allows you to set the saturation of the camera
content1: Allows you to control the color saturation level of the camera image.
content2:
DensiCAMControlRange struct holds the saturation range and current value:
  - min: Minimum saturation value.
  - max: Maximum saturation value.
  - def: Default saturation value.
  - cur: Current saturation value.
  - res: Resolution step.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the saturation range and current value of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the saturation of the camera.

tooltip: Sharpness : Allows you to set the sharpness of the camera
content1: Allows you to control the sharpness level applied to the camera image.
content2:
DensiCAMControlRange struct holds the sharpness range and current value:
  - min: Minimum sharpness value.
  - max: Maximum sharpness value.
  - def: Default sharpness value.
  - cur: Current sharpness value.
  - res: Resolution step.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the sharpness range and current value of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the sharpness of the camera.

tooltip: Gamma : Allows you to set the gamma of the camera
content1: Allows you to control the gamma correction applied to the camera image. Gamma correction affects the overall luminance of the image.
content2:
DensiCAMControlRange16 struct holds the gamma range and current value (16-bit):
  - min: Minimum gamma value.
  - max: Maximum gamma value.
  - def: Default gamma value.
  - cur: Current gamma value.
  - res: Resolution step.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the gamma range and current value of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the gamma correction value of the camera.

tooltip: Gain : Allows you to set the gain of the camera
content1: Allows you to control the gain level of the camera sensor. Higher gain increases image brightness but may also increase noise.
content2:
DensiCAMControlRange struct holds the gain range and current value:
  - min: Minimum gain value.
  - max: Maximum gain value.
  - def: Default gain value.
  - cur: Current gain value.
  - res: Resolution step.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the gain range and current value of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the gain of the camera.

tooltip: Exposure : Allows you to control the exposure mode and exposure time of the camera
content1: Allows you to switch between Auto and Manual exposure modes. In Manual mode, the exposure time can be set directly.
content2:
DensiCAMControlRange32 struct holds the manual exposure range and current value (32-bit):
  - min: Minimum exposure time.
  - max: Maximum exposure time.
  - def: Default exposure time.
  - cur: Current exposure time.
  - res: Resolution step.
getAPIDes: getAutoExposure retrieves whether auto exposure is active (1 = AUTO, 0 = MANUAL). getManualExposure retrieves the manual exposure time range and current value.
setAPIHeading: bool setAutoExposure(uint8_t value) / bool setManualExposure(uint32_t value)
setAPIDes: setAutoExposure enables (1) or disables (0) auto exposure. setManualExposure sets the manual exposure time in microseconds.

tooltip: White Balance : Allows you to control the white balance mode and value of the camera
content1: Allows you to switch between Auto and Manual white balance modes. In Manual mode, the white balance value can be set directly.
content2:
DensiCAMControlRange16 struct holds the manual white balance range and current value (16-bit):
  - min: Minimum white balance value.
  - max: Maximum white balance value.
  - def: Default white balance value.
  - cur: Current white balance value.
  - res: Resolution step.
getAPIDes: getAutoWhiteBalance retrieves whether auto white balance is active (1 = AUTO, 0 = MANUAL). getManualWhiteBalance retrieves the manual white balance range and current value.
setAPIHeading: bool setAutoWhiteBalance(uint8_t value) / bool setManualWhiteBalance(uint16_t value)
setAPIDes: setAutoWhiteBalance enables (1) or disables (0) auto white balance. setManualWhiteBalance sets the manual white balance value.

tooltip: Image Capture : Allows you to set the image capture mode of the camera
content1: Allows you to configure how image capture is triggered : either via a physical button/software or through TWAIN/CamVistra interface.
content2:
DensiCAMImageCapture Enum indicates the image capture mode:
  1. CAPTURE_BUTTON_SOFTWARE (0x01) : Button or software-triggered capture.
  2. CAPTURE_TWAIN_CAMVISTRA (0x02) : TWAIN or CamVistra interface capture.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current image capture mode of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the image capture mode of the camera.

tooltip: Unique ID : Reads the 64-bit unique device identifier of the camera
content1: Reads the 64-bit unique hardware identifier of the DensiCAM device. The ID is split into two 32-bit parts and returned as a 16-character hexadecimal string.
content2:
DensiCAMUniqueID struct holds both 32-bit parts of the unique ID:
  - part1: Upper 32 bits of the unique ID.
  - part2: Lower 32 bits of the unique ID.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the 64-bit unique hardware ID of the camera as two 32-bit values.

tooltip: Firmware Version : Reads the firmware version of the camera
content1: Reads the current firmware version string from the DensiCAM device.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the firmware version of the camera as a dot-separated version string.

tooltip: Save Configuration : Saves the current camera settings to non-volatile memory
content1: Saves all current camera control settings to the device's non-volatile memory so they persist after power cycling.
setAPIDes: This function saves the current camera configuration to non-volatile memory.

tooltip: Restore Defaults : Restores all camera settings to factory defaults
content1: Resets all camera control settings back to their factory default values.
setAPIDes: This function restores all camera settings to factory defaults.
